messages.subject: dateInput background color
parts:
Hello,

How may I change the background color of the date field of the dateInput()? This works:

numericInput("numeric_id","Number:",5)
tags$style("#numeric_id {background-color: transparent}")

but this does not work:

dateInput("date_id","Date:")
tags$style("#date_id {background-color: transparent}")

I did find that this makes the popup calendar transparent:

tags$style(".datepicker {background-color: transparent}")

But that is not what I want. I want the field that shows the selected date to be transparent, not the popup calendar.


Jonathan
